claimLevel: Retrospective discrete-model analysis; no physical validation or grid independence.

method.time: Start is the early row actual switch boundary; all three arms sampled at common absolute times. The broad control has a different starting geometry. Recorded at-or-before states plus next events, no interpolation.
method.increment: New attachments after start state through end state. Counts include kinetic and geometric-completion attachments and exclude partial fill; these are occupancy increments, not mass or isolated kinetic uptake.
method.envelope: Outside starting axial envelope means k below starting minimum or above starting maximum; its complement includes lateral expansion as well as interior additions.
method.bracketRanges: Extrema over recorded start/end bracket combinations, using the exact state alone at an exact event time; not continuous bounds.
method.openings: Existing center-component flood fill and straight axial opening helper; signed layers are not separate cavities.
